nodes.description: Address stored by CTokenAdminStorage; set to msg.sender by the creator and then to admin_ after initialization.
Address of the implementation contract the delegator forwards all calls to via delegatecall.
CEtherDelegator constructor that sets admin to msg.sender, delegatecalls initialize on the implementation and registers the first implementation.
Admin-only setter that swaps the implementation address and optionally calls _resignImplementation/_becomeImplementation on it.
Internal helper performing callee.delegatecall(data) and bubbling up revert data on failure.
Public wrapper that delegatecalls the current implementation with caller-supplied data.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls the implementation with msg.data and returns or reverts the raw returndata.
Caller of the constructor, used to seed the admin storage slot.
delegatecall to an externally supplied callee inside delegateTo, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context.
delegatecall to the stored implementation with raw msg.data in the fallback function.
hasAdminRights() check gating _setImplementation; the only access-control barrier protecting the implementation swap.
Address of the contract delegateTo delegatecalls.
Raw calldata bytes forwarded to callee in delegateTo.
New implementation address supplied to _setImplementation.
Boolean flag controlling whether _resignImplementation is called on the old implementation.
Encoded bytes passed to _becomeImplementation on the new implementation.
Temporary holding the previous implementation address before it is overwritten and emitted.
Raw bytes forwarded by delegateToImplementation to delegateTo.
Implementation address passed to the constructor for the initial delegatecall.
Encoded becomeImplementation data passed to _setImplementation from the constructor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the admin storage slot during construction, granting the deployer privileged control.
The constructor invokes delegateTo, triggering the delegatecall to the newly supplied implementation.
The constructor calls _setImplementation, which is protected by the hasAdminRights check.
_setImplementation routes _resignImplementation/_becomeImplementation calls through delegateToImplementation into delegateTo.
delegateToImplementation forwards execution into the internal delegateTo helper.
The fallback delegatecalls the implementation with raw msg.data, giving arbitrary external code full control of this storage context.
The stored implementation address is the target of the fallback delegatecall.
The stored implementation address is the callee used by delegateToImplementation/delegateTo.
The implementation_ parameter rewrites the implementation storage variable, redirecting all future delegatecalls.
The previous implementation value is captured before the storage variable is overwritten.
The callee parameter is the destination of the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
The data parameter is the raw payload executed by the delegatecall inside delegateTo.
Caller-supplied data flows from delegateToImplementation into delegateTo.
The constructor implementation_ argument is used as the callee of the initial delegatecall.
becomeImplementationData is encoded and forwarded through delegateToImplementation into delegateTo.
_setImplementation is guarded by the hasAdminRights requirement before any implementation change.

normalization_plan.reason: callee is a transient argument consumed only by the delegatecall in delegateTo and carries no independent semantic identity.
data is a transient argument consumed only by the delegatecall in delegateTo.
implementation_ exists only to update the implementation state variable inside _setImplementation.
allowResign only branches the internal resign call inside _setImplementation.
becomeImplementationData is only encoded and forwarded by _setImplementation.
oldImplementation is a short-lived local used only for the swap and event inside _setImplementation.
data is a pass-through argument consumed only by delegateTo inside delegateToImplementation.
implementation_ is consumed only by the constructor to seed the delegation target.
becomeImplementationData is consumed only by the constructor when calling _setImplementation.
